title: Full Stack Developer
subtitle: Step by step guide to becoming a modern full stack developer in 2026
description: The definitive roadmap for full-stack software engineers. Covers web fundamentals, type-safe frontend reactive frameworks, high-throughput backend runtimes, relational & NoSQL databases, API architectures, containerization, CI/CD, and distributed system design.

stages.title: Internet & Web Fundamentals
stages.tagline: Understand the underlying protocols and mechanics of how the worldwide web operates.
stages.description: Before writing frontend or backend code, you must understand how data travels across the globe, how DNS maps names to IP addresses, and how browsers parse responses.

topics.title: How does the Internet Work?
topics.description: The physical and logical infrastructure connecting billions of computers worldwide through packet switching, TCP/IP, and internet service providers.
whatToLearn: Packet switching and IP addressing (IPv4 vs IPv6)
The OSI 7-Layer Model vs TCP/IP stack
Routers, switches, optical cables, and border gateway protocol (BGP)
Latency, bandwidth, packet loss, and jitter
topics.practiceChallenge: Use traceroute / ping in terminal to track packets from your machine to github.com.

topics.title: HTTP / HTTPS Protocols
topics.description: The foundational client-server communication protocol for transferring hypertext, JSON payloads, and media across the web.
whatToLearn: HTTP request methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD
HTTP status codes (1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx)
Headers: Content-Type, Authorization, Cache-Control, User-Agent
HTTPS & TLS/SSL handshake encryption
HTTP/2 multiplexing vs HTTP/3 (QUIC over UDP)
topics.practiceChallenge: Inspect network tab in DevTools and inspect request/response headers for 5 different websites.

topics.title: DNS & Domain Resolution
topics.description: The phonebook of the Internet. Resolves human-readable domain names like yaswant.co.in into machine-routable IP addresses.
whatToLearn: Root nameservers, TLD nameservers, and authoritative DNS
DNS Record Types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA
DNS propagation and Time-To-Live (TTL)
DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and DNS security extensions (DNSSEC)
topics.practiceChallenge: Use dig or nslookup to query the A and MX records of google.com and your custom domain.

topics.title: Browsers & Rendering Engines
topics.description: How modern web browsers (Chromium, Gecko, WebKit) parse HTML/CSS, build the DOM and CSSOM, execute JavaScript, and paint pixels.
whatToLearn: DOM tree and CSSOM construction
The Render Tree, Layout (Reflow), and Paint (Repaint)
Critical Rendering Path (CRP) optimization
JavaScript execution thread and the Browser Event Loop
topics.practiceChallenge: Profile a web page in Chrome DevTools Performance tab and identify layout shifts and long tasks.

stages.title: Frontend Foundations (HTML, CSS, JS)
stages.tagline: The three core building blocks of all user interfaces on the modern web.
stages.description: Every web engineer must write clean, accessible, semantic markup, build responsive layouts, and master JavaScript as a programming language.

topics.title: HTML5 & Semantic Markup
topics.description: Structure web documents using meaningful tags that screen readers, search engines, and browsers understand natively.
whatToLearn: Semantic elements: <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>, <footer>
Accessible forms: <form>, <input>, <label>, <fieldset>, <select>, validation attributes
Web Accessibility (WCAG & WAI-ARIA roles, aria-live, aria-expanded)
SEO metadata tags, Open Graph, and Structured Data (JSON-LD)
topics.practiceChallenge: Build an accessible checkout form with client-side validation and semantic ARIA attributes without JavaScript.

topics.title: Modern CSS, Flexbox & Grid
topics.description: Master CSS layouts, the Box Model, modern responsive typography, custom properties (variables), and animations.
whatToLearn: The CSS Box Model (margin, border, padding, content-box vs border-box)
Flexbox: justify-content, align-items, flex-direction, flex-wrap, gap
CSS Grid: grid-template-columns, fr units, minmax, auto-fit, auto-fill
Responsive Design: fluid clamp(), container queries, media queries
CSS Custom Properties (Variables) & Dark Mode theming
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a responsive 12-column dashboard layout with CSS Grid that collapses cleanly on mobile devices.

topics.title: JavaScript (ES6+ Deep Dive)
topics.description: The primary language of the web. Learn closures, prototypes, asynchronous programming, and DOM manipulation.
whatToLearn: Data types, scoping (let, const, var), hoisting, and closures
Arrow functions, destructuring, rest/spread operators, template literals
Array methods: map, filter, reduce, find, some, every, sort
Asynchronous JS: Event Loop, Callbacks, Promises, and async/await
DOM Manipulation, Event Bubbling, Delegation, and fetch() API
topics.practiceChallenge: Build an interactive weather dashboard consuming a public API using async/await with error handling.

topics.title: TypeScript (Type-Safe JS)
topics.description: Static typing for JavaScript. Catches errors during development and powers enterprise full-stack codebases.
whatToLearn: Primitive types, interfaces, and type aliases
Generics: reusable classes, functions, and interfaces
Union types, intersection types, and type narrowing
Utility types: Partial, Pick, Omit, Record, Readonly
tsconfig.json strict mode configurations
topics.practiceChallenge: Convert a 200-line vanilla JS API client to strict TypeScript with zero any types.

stages.title: Git, VCS & Package Managers
stages.tagline: Essential developer workflow tools for tracking code history and managing third-party modules.
stages.description: Professional engineering requires mastering Git branching workflows, resolving merge conflicts, and leveraging package managers.

topics.title: Git & GitHub Workflows
topics.description: Distributed version control system to track changes in source code during software development.
whatToLearn: Core commands: git init, add, commit, status, log, diff
Branching strategies: Git Flow, Trunk-based development
Merging vs Rebasing (fast-forward, interactive rebase)
Resolving merge conflicts and cherry-picking commits
GitHub Pull Requests, code reviews, and issue tracking
topics.practiceChallenge: Create a repository, make 3 feature branches, trigger an intentional merge conflict, and resolve it cleanly.

topics.title: Package Managers (npm, pnpm)
topics.description: Tools for installing, updating, and managing third-party open-source libraries and scripts.
whatToLearn: package.json scripts, dependencies vs devDependencies
Semantic Versioning (SemVer: major, minor, patch, caret, tilde)
Lockfiles (package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml) and determinism
pnpm content-addressable storage & workspace monorepos
topics.practiceChallenge: Initialize a pnpm workspace monorepo with a shared UI package and two apps.

topics.title: Build Tools & Bundlers (Vite)
topics.description: Next-generation frontend tooling powered by native ES modules (ESM) and lightning-fast Rollup/esbuild.
whatToLearn: Native ESM in development vs bundled production output
Hot Module Replacement (HMR) architecture
Code splitting, dynamic imports, and chunk optimization
Environment variables (.env, import.meta.env) in Vite
topics.practiceChallenge: Configure a custom vite.config.ts with rollupOptions manualChunks to split vendor libraries.

stages.title: Frontend Frameworks & State
stages.tagline: Build declarative, reactive, and reusable user interfaces with industry-standard component libraries.
stages.description: Component-driven frontend architectures dominate modern engineering. Master React 19, state management, and utility-first CSS.

topics.title: React 19 & Component Architecture
topics.description: The world’s most popular declarative UI library. Master functional components, hooks, and reconciliation.
whatToLearn: JSX syntax, props, children, and component composition
Core Hooks: useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback
React 19 Hooks: useActionState, useOptimistic, useFormStatus
Controlled vs uncontrolled form components
Error boundaries, Suspense, and lazy loading
topics.practiceChallenge: Build an e-commerce product catalog with interactive filters, sorting, and optimistic cart updates.

topics.title: Tailwind CSS (Utility-First)
topics.description: Rapidly build modern designs without ever leaving your HTML/JSX using composable atomic utility classes.
whatToLearn: Utility-first philosophy vs traditional BEM CSS
Responsive modifiers (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:)
State variants (hover:, focus:, active:, disabled:, dark:)
Custom themes, color palettes, and arbitrary values
topics.practiceChallenge: Recreate a sleek Stripe-style landing hero section purely using Tailwind CSS utility classes.

topics.title: State Management (Zustand & TanStack Query)
topics.description: Separate client UI state from asynchronous server cache state with clean, boilerplate-free stores.
whatToLearn: Client State vs Server State distinction
Zustand store creation, selectors, and middleware (persist)
TanStack Query: useQuery, useMutation, query keys, invalidation
Optimistic updates and background refetching
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a Kanban board with Zustand for column state and TanStack Query for background sync.

topics.title: Next.js 15 (App Router & SSR)
topics.description: The enterprise React framework. Hybrid Server Components, static generation (SSG), and Server Actions.
whatToLearn: App Router file conventions: page, layout, loading, error, not-found
React Server Components (RSC) vs Client Components ("use client")
Server Actions for type-safe form submissions
Static Site Generation (SSG), SSR, and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a full-featured blog with Server Components, dynamic slug routing, and Server Action comments.

stages.title: Backend Runtimes & Languages
stages.tagline: Power server-side logic, handle HTTP requests, and execute business rules.
stages.description: Choose a primary backend runtime. JavaScript/TypeScript developers typically excel with Node.js, while enterprise systems often use Python or Go.

topics.title: Node.js & Express.js / Hono
topics.description: V8-powered asynchronous, non-blocking I/O JavaScript runtime for building scalable server-side applications.
whatToLearn: Node.js Event Loop, streams, and file system (fs/promises)
Building HTTP servers, middleware architecture, and routing
Request parsing, query params, path params, and body parsers
Centralized error-handling middleware and status codes
Modern lightweight alternatives: Hono, Fastify
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a production-grade REST API with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and structured logging.

topics.title: Python (FastAPI / Django)
topics.description: High-level programming language dominant in AI/ML, data science, and clean asynchronous microservices.
whatToLearn: FastAPI async def routes and automatic OpenAPI/Swagger docs
Pydantic models for data validation and serialization
Dependency injection in FastAPI
Django batteries-included MVC, ORM, and admin portal
topics.practiceChallenge: Create a microservice in FastAPI with Pydantic validation that predicts text sentiment or processes files.

topics.title: Go (Golang)
topics.description: Statically-typed, compiled language developed by Google for high-concurrency distributed systems.
whatToLearn: Goroutines and Channels for lightweight concurrency
Structs, interfaces, and implicit implementation
Standard net/http library and Gin/Echo frameworks
Memory management and compile-to-single-binary deployment
topics.practiceChallenge: Write a concurrent URL health checker in Go that pings 50 endpoints concurrently using worker pools.

stages.title: Databases & ORMs (SQL & NoSQL)
stages.tagline: Reliable, ACID-compliant data persistence, indexing, and schema design.
stages.description: Applications live and die by their data layer. Master relational schemas in PostgreSQL and high-speed key-value caching in Redis.

topics.title: PostgreSQL (Relational SQL)
topics.description: The world’s most advanced open-source object-relational database system with robust ACID guarantees.
whatToLearn: Relational modeling: 1-to-1, 1-to-many, many-to-many junction tables
SQL Joins (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL) and aggregations (GROUP BY, HAVING)
ACID properties, transactions, and isolation levels
Database indexing: B-Tree, GIN, composite indexes, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Foreign keys, cascading updates/deletes, and constraints
topics.practiceChallenge: Design an e-commerce schema (Users, Orders, Items, Inventory) with transactional order checkout.

topics.title: ORMs: Prisma & Drizzle
topics.description: Type-safe database toolkits for TypeScript that generate SQL queries without sacrificing type safety.
whatToLearn: Prisma Schema definition, relations, and migrations (prisma migrate)
Type-safe querying: findUnique, findMany, include, select, transactions
Drizzle ORM: SQL-like syntax with zero bundle overhead
Database connection pooling in serverless environments
topics.practiceChallenge: Write automated seed scripts and migrations using Prisma connecting to a live PostgreSQL database.

topics.title: Redis (In-Memory Key-Value & Cache)
topics.description: Ultra-fast in-memory data store used for database query caching, user sessions, rate limiting, and pub/sub.
whatToLearn: Data structures: Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets, Sorted Sets
TTL (Time-to-Live) expiration and eviction policies (LRU)
Caching strategies: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, Write-Behind
Distributed locks and sliding window rate limiting
topics.practiceChallenge: Implement Redis caching on a heavy database endpoint with automatic 60-second cache invalidation.

topics.title: MongoDB (Document NoSQL)
topics.description: JSON-like flexible document database suitable for rapidly evolving schemas and unstructured data.
whatToLearn: BSON document model, collections, and ObjectIDs
Mongoose ODM schemas, validation, and virtuals
Aggregation Pipeline ($match, $group, $project, $lookup)
When to choose SQL vs NoSQL document stores
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a multi-stage aggregation pipeline calculating monthly sales statistics from raw order documents.

stages.title: API Architectures & Protocols
stages.tagline: How frontend and backend exchange data efficiently and reliably.
stages.description: Full stack developers must design clean, predictable, documented APIs following international web standards.

topics.title: RESTful API Design Best Practices
topics.description: Architectural style for designing networked applications relying on standard HTTP verbs and stateless endpoints.
whatToLearn: Resource naming conventions (/api/v1/users/:id/orders)
Idempotency of GET, PUT, DELETE vs non-idempotent POST
Pagination patterns (offset/limit vs cursor-based pagination)
Filtering, sorting, and field selection query parameters
OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger specification documentation
topics.practiceChallenge: Document and implement a cursor-based paginated REST API endpoint with Swagger UI integration.

topics.title: WebSockets & Server-Sent Events
topics.description: Persistent full-duplex TCP connections for real-time live chat, notifications, and telemetry feeds.
whatToLearn: WebSocket handshake upgrade protocol (ws:// and wss://)
Socket.IO vs native WebSocket API
Heartbeat ping/pong and auto-reconnection logic
Server-Sent Events (SSE) for one-way streaming (e.g. AI LLM tokens)
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a real-time collaborative chat room with live typing indicators and online user lists.

topics.title: GraphQL (Client-Driven Queries)
topics.description: A query language for your API that allows clients to request exactly what they need and nothing more.
whatToLearn: Schema Definition Language (SDL): Types, Queries, Mutations
Resolvers and context handling
Solving the N+1 problem using DataLoader
GraphQL Subscriptions for real-time updates
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a GraphQL server with Apollo Server and optimize relations using DataLoader.

stages.title: Authentication & Web Security
stages.tagline: Safeguard user identities, protect against cyber attacks, and enforce access controls.
stages.description: Security is not an afterthought. Learn cryptographic password hashing, token validation, and OWASP defense patterns.

topics.title: JWT Tokens & HttpOnly Cookie Sessions
topics.description: Stateless JSON Web Tokens and secure session cookie storage for verifying user identity.
whatToLearn: Structure of JWT: Header, Payload, Signature
Access Token (short-lived) + Refresh Token (long-lived) rotation
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie flags (preventing XSS theft)
Password hashing with bcrypt / argon2 (salting & work factors)
topics.practiceChallenge: Implement refresh token rotation with blacklist revocation in a Node.js / Express API.

topics.title: OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect
topics.description: Industry standard protocol for authorization allowing users to sign in with Google, GitHub, or Apple.
whatToLearn: Authorization Code Grant Flow with PKCE
Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI, and Scopes
ID Tokens vs Access Tokens in OIDC
Integrating Google / GitHub OAuth providers
topics.practiceChallenge: Add "Sign In With GitHub" to your web application using standard OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow.

topics.title: OWASP Top 10 Security Defenses
topics.description: Protect applications against common vulnerabilities: Injection, Broken Auth, XSS, CSRF, and Misconfigurations.
whatToLearn: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS): Stored, Reflected, DOM-based & Content Security Policy (CSP)
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) & SameSite cookies
SQL Injection (SQLi) & parameterized queries
CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) headers and preflight checks
Rate limiting, IP blacklisting, and DDOS mitigation
topics.practiceChallenge: Audit an existing web API for missing security headers, CSRF vulnerabilities, and SQL injection risks.

stages.title: Testing & Code Quality
stages.tagline: Write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that ensure production reliability.
stages.description: High-performing engineering teams ship features with confidence by maintaining solid automated test suites.

topics.title: Unit Testing (Vitest / Jest)
topics.description: Fast, isolated testing of individual pure functions, algorithms, and business logic utilities.
whatToLearn: Test anatomy: describe, it/test, expect, assertions
Mocking functions, modules, and API calls (vi.fn, vi.spyOn)
Test coverage metrics (statements, branches, functions, lines)
Testing React components with React Testing Library
topics.practiceChallenge: Write unit tests achieving 90%+ branch coverage for a financial billing calculator module.

topics.title: E2E Testing (Playwright)
topics.description: Automate real browser engines (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) to test complete user journeys end-to-end.
whatToLearn: Headless vs headed browser execution
Locators, auto-waiting, user actions (click, fill, press)
Network mocking and route interception in Playwright
Visual regression testing and screenshot comparisons
topics.practiceChallenge: Write an automated Playwright test that logs in, adds an item to cart, and verifies the total price.

stages.title: Docker, CI/CD & Cloud Deployment
stages.tagline: Package software into reproducible containers and automate continuous delivery to the cloud.
stages.description: A true full-stack engineer knows how to take raw code, containerize it, and deploy it securely to production servers.

topics.title: Docker & Containerization
topics.description: Package applications and all their dependencies into a standardized, isolated container unit.
whatToLearn: Images vs Containers, Docker Hub registry
Writing multi-stage Dockerfiles (build stage vs production stage)
Docker Compose for multi-service environments (App + Postgres + Redis)
Volumes for persistent storage and bridge networks
topics.practiceChallenge: Create a docker-compose.yml file that orchestrates a Next.js frontend, Node.js API, and PostgreSQL.

topics.title: CI/CD with GitHub Actions
topics.description: Automate testing, linting, building, and deployment pipelines directly on every push or pull request.
whatToLearn: Workflow YAML syntax: triggers, jobs, steps, runners
Matrix builds for multi-version testing
GitHub Secrets management for API keys and deployment credentials
Automated SSH deployment or Docker image build & push to registry
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a GitHub Actions workflow that runs linter, tests, builds production bundle, and notifies on failure.

topics.title: Web Servers & Reverse Proxy (Nginx)
topics.description: High-performance HTTP server, reverse proxy, and load balancer for routing traffic to backend containers.
whatToLearn: Reverse proxy configuration (proxy_pass to local ports)
SSL termination with Let’s Encrypt Certbot
Gzip compression, static file caching, and client body limits
Load balancing algorithms: round-robin, least connections, ip_hash
topics.practiceChallenge: Configure an Nginx reverse proxy routing requests for /api to a Node app and /* to static HTML files.

topics.title: Cloud VPS & Production Hosting
topics.description: Deploy real applications to Linux VPS servers (Hostinger VPS, DigitalOcean) and manage system services.
whatToLearn: Linux server administration basics (Ubuntu, SSH keys, ufw firewall)
Process management with PM2 / systemd services
Automated backups, log rotation, and disk space monitoring
Custom domain DNS mapping and free SSL certificates
topics.practiceChallenge: Provision an Ubuntu server, set up SSH key auth, configure UFW firewall, and run an app with PM2.

stages.title: System Design & Distributed Systems
stages.tagline: Scale web applications to millions of concurrent users with fault-tolerant, resilient architectures.
stages.description: The transition from mid-level to senior/staff engineer requires mastering scalability bottlenecks, database sharding, and messaging queues.

topics.title: Monolith vs Microservices Architecture
topics.description: Evaluate architectural trade-offs between modular monoliths and independently deployable microservices.
whatToLearn: Modular Monolith advantages, boundaries, and domain-driven design (DDD)
Microservices challenges: network latency, distributed transactions, data consistency
API Gateway pattern and service mesh
Eventual consistency and the CAP theorem
topics.practiceChallenge: Design an architecture diagram for an Uber or Netflix scale system detailing service boundaries.

topics.title: Message Queues & Event Streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
topics.description: Asynchronous task processing and high-throughput event streaming between decoupled services.
whatToLearn: Point-to-point queues (RabbitMQ, SQS) vs Event logs (Apache Kafka)
Producers, Consumers, Consumer Groups, and Partitions
Background worker queues (BullMQ with Redis in Node.js)
Handling poison pills, dead-letter queues (DLQ), and retry exponential backoff
topics.practiceChallenge: Build an asynchronous email / video processing worker queue with BullMQ and Redis.

topics.title: Observability (Logging, Metrics, Tracing)
topics.description: Know what is happening inside production systems before users report bugs.
whatToLearn: Structured JSON logging (Pino, Winston) and log correlation IDs
Application metrics with Prometheus & visualization in Grafana
Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry
Real-time error monitoring and alerting (Sentry)
topics.practiceChallenge: Add distributed correlation IDs to all incoming requests and trace them across HTTP headers.

topics.title: Tailwind CSS (Utility-First)
topics.description: Rapidly build modern designs without ever leaving your HTML/JSX using composable atomic utility classes.
whatToLearn: Utility-first philosophy vs traditional BEM CSS
Responsive modifiers (sm:, md:, lg:, xl:)
State variants (hover:, focus:, active:, disabled:, dark:)
Custom themes, color palettes, and arbitrary values
topics.practiceChallenge: Recreate a sleek Stripe-style landing hero section purely using Tailwind CSS utility classes.

topics.title: State Management (Zustand & TanStack Query)
topics.description: Separate client UI state from asynchronous server cache state with clean, boilerplate-free stores.
whatToLearn: Client State vs Server State distinction
Zustand store creation, selectors, and middleware (persist)
TanStack Query: useQuery, useMutation, query keys, invalidation
Optimistic updates and background refetching
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a Kanban board with Zustand for column state and TanStack Query for background sync.

topics.title: Next.js 15 (App Router & SSR)
topics.description: The enterprise React framework. Hybrid Server Components, static generation (SSG), and Server Actions.
whatToLearn: App Router file conventions: page, layout, loading, error, not-found
React Server Components (RSC) vs Client Components ("use client")
Server Actions for type-safe form submissions
Static Site Generation (SSG), SSR, and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR)
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a full-featured blog with Server Components, dynamic slug routing, and Server Action comments.

stages.title: Testing & Code Quality
stages.tagline: Write automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that ensure production reliability.
stages.description: High-performing engineering teams ship features with confidence by maintaining solid automated test suites.

topics.title: Unit Testing (Vitest / Jest)
topics.description: Fast, isolated testing of individual pure functions, algorithms, and business logic utilities.
whatToLearn: Test anatomy: describe, it/test, expect, assertions
Mocking functions, modules, and API calls (vi.fn, vi.spyOn)
Test coverage metrics (statements, branches, functions, lines)
Testing React components with React Testing Library
topics.practiceChallenge: Write unit tests achieving 90%+ branch coverage for a financial billing calculator module.

topics.title: E2E Testing (Playwright)
topics.description: Automate real browser engines (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) to test complete user journeys end-to-end.
whatToLearn: Headless vs headed browser execution
Locators, auto-waiting, user actions (click, fill, press)
Network mocking and route interception in Playwright
Visual regression testing and screenshot comparisons
topics.practiceChallenge: Write an automated Playwright test that logs in, adds an item to cart, and verifies the total price.

title: Backend Developer
subtitle: Step by step guide to becoming a modern backend developer in 2026
description: Master Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, REST/GraphQL APIs, Authentication, Web Security, and System Design.

stages.title: Internet & Web Fundamentals
stages.tagline: Understand the underlying protocols and mechanics of how the worldwide web operates.
stages.description: Before writing frontend or backend code, you must understand how data travels across the globe, how DNS maps names to IP addresses, and how browsers parse responses.

topics.title: How does the Internet Work?
topics.description: The physical and logical infrastructure connecting billions of computers worldwide through packet switching, TCP/IP, and internet service providers.
whatToLearn: Packet switching and IP addressing (IPv4 vs IPv6)
The OSI 7-Layer Model vs TCP/IP stack
Routers, switches, optical cables, and border gateway protocol (BGP)
Latency, bandwidth, packet loss, and jitter
topics.practiceChallenge: Use traceroute / ping in terminal to track packets from your machine to github.com.

topics.title: HTTP / HTTPS Protocols
topics.description: The foundational client-server communication protocol for transferring hypertext, JSON payloads, and media across the web.
whatToLearn: HTTP request methods: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, HEAD
HTTP status codes (1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx)
Headers: Content-Type, Authorization, Cache-Control, User-Agent
HTTPS & TLS/SSL handshake encryption
HTTP/2 multiplexing vs HTTP/3 (QUIC over UDP)
topics.practiceChallenge: Inspect network tab in DevTools and inspect request/response headers for 5 different websites.

topics.title: DNS & Domain Resolution
topics.description: The phonebook of the Internet. Resolves human-readable domain names like yaswant.co.in into machine-routable IP addresses.
whatToLearn: Root nameservers, TLD nameservers, and authoritative DNS
DNS Record Types: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA
DNS propagation and Time-To-Live (TTL)
DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and DNS security extensions (DNSSEC)
topics.practiceChallenge: Use dig or nslookup to query the A and MX records of google.com and your custom domain.

topics.title: Browsers & Rendering Engines
topics.description: How modern web browsers (Chromium, Gecko, WebKit) parse HTML/CSS, build the DOM and CSSOM, execute JavaScript, and paint pixels.
whatToLearn: DOM tree and CSSOM construction
The Render Tree, Layout (Reflow), and Paint (Repaint)
Critical Rendering Path (CRP) optimization
JavaScript execution thread and the Browser Event Loop
topics.practiceChallenge: Profile a web page in Chrome DevTools Performance tab and identify layout shifts and long tasks.

stages.title: Git, VCS & Package Managers
stages.tagline: Essential developer workflow tools for tracking code history and managing third-party modules.
stages.description: Professional engineering requires mastering Git branching workflows, resolving merge conflicts, and leveraging package managers.

topics.title: Git & GitHub Workflows
topics.description: Distributed version control system to track changes in source code during software development.
whatToLearn: Core commands: git init, add, commit, status, log, diff
Branching strategies: Git Flow, Trunk-based development
Merging vs Rebasing (fast-forward, interactive rebase)
Resolving merge conflicts and cherry-picking commits
GitHub Pull Requests, code reviews, and issue tracking
topics.practiceChallenge: Create a repository, make 3 feature branches, trigger an intentional merge conflict, and resolve it cleanly.

topics.title: Package Managers (npm, pnpm)
topics.description: Tools for installing, updating, and managing third-party open-source libraries and scripts.
whatToLearn: package.json scripts, dependencies vs devDependencies
Semantic Versioning (SemVer: major, minor, patch, caret, tilde)
Lockfiles (package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml) and determinism
pnpm content-addressable storage & workspace monorepos
topics.practiceChallenge: Initialize a pnpm workspace monorepo with a shared UI package and two apps.

topics.title: Build Tools & Bundlers (Vite)
topics.description: Next-generation frontend tooling powered by native ES modules (ESM) and lightning-fast Rollup/esbuild.
whatToLearn: Native ESM in development vs bundled production output
Hot Module Replacement (HMR) architecture
Code splitting, dynamic imports, and chunk optimization
Environment variables (.env, import.meta.env) in Vite
topics.practiceChallenge: Configure a custom vite.config.ts with rollupOptions manualChunks to split vendor libraries.

stages.title: Backend Runtimes & Languages
stages.tagline: Power server-side logic, handle HTTP requests, and execute business rules.
stages.description: Choose a primary backend runtime. JavaScript/TypeScript developers typically excel with Node.js, while enterprise systems often use Python or Go.

topics.title: Node.js & Express.js / Hono
topics.description: V8-powered asynchronous, non-blocking I/O JavaScript runtime for building scalable server-side applications.
whatToLearn: Node.js Event Loop, streams, and file system (fs/promises)
Building HTTP servers, middleware architecture, and routing
Request parsing, query params, path params, and body parsers
Centralized error-handling middleware and status codes
Modern lightweight alternatives: Hono, Fastify
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a production-grade REST API with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and structured logging.

topics.title: Python (FastAPI / Django)
topics.description: High-level programming language dominant in AI/ML, data science, and clean asynchronous microservices.
whatToLearn: FastAPI async def routes and automatic OpenAPI/Swagger docs
Pydantic models for data validation and serialization
Dependency injection in FastAPI
Django batteries-included MVC, ORM, and admin portal
topics.practiceChallenge: Create a microservice in FastAPI with Pydantic validation that predicts text sentiment or processes files.

topics.title: Go (Golang)
topics.description: Statically-typed, compiled language developed by Google for high-concurrency distributed systems.
whatToLearn: Goroutines and Channels for lightweight concurrency
Structs, interfaces, and implicit implementation
Standard net/http library and Gin/Echo frameworks
Memory management and compile-to-single-binary deployment
topics.practiceChallenge: Write a concurrent URL health checker in Go that pings 50 endpoints concurrently using worker pools.

stages.title: Databases & ORMs (SQL & NoSQL)
stages.tagline: Reliable, ACID-compliant data persistence, indexing, and schema design.
stages.description: Applications live and die by their data layer. Master relational schemas in PostgreSQL and high-speed key-value caching in Redis.

topics.title: PostgreSQL (Relational SQL)
topics.description: The world’s most advanced open-source object-relational database system with robust ACID guarantees.
whatToLearn: Relational modeling: 1-to-1, 1-to-many, many-to-many junction tables
SQL Joins (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL) and aggregations (GROUP BY, HAVING)
ACID properties, transactions, and isolation levels
Database indexing: B-Tree, GIN, composite indexes, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE
Foreign keys, cascading updates/deletes, and constraints
topics.practiceChallenge: Design an e-commerce schema (Users, Orders, Items, Inventory) with transactional order checkout.

topics.title: ORMs: Prisma & Drizzle
topics.description: Type-safe database toolkits for TypeScript that generate SQL queries without sacrificing type safety.
whatToLearn: Prisma Schema definition, relations, and migrations (prisma migrate)
Type-safe querying: findUnique, findMany, include, select, transactions
Drizzle ORM: SQL-like syntax with zero bundle overhead
Database connection pooling in serverless environments
topics.practiceChallenge: Write automated seed scripts and migrations using Prisma connecting to a live PostgreSQL database.

topics.title: Redis (In-Memory Key-Value & Cache)
topics.description: Ultra-fast in-memory data store used for database query caching, user sessions, rate limiting, and pub/sub.
whatToLearn: Data structures: Strings, Hashes, Lists, Sets, Sorted Sets
TTL (Time-to-Live) expiration and eviction policies (LRU)
Caching strategies: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, Write-Behind
Distributed locks and sliding window rate limiting
topics.practiceChallenge: Implement Redis caching on a heavy database endpoint with automatic 60-second cache invalidation.

topics.title: MongoDB (Document NoSQL)
topics.description: JSON-like flexible document database suitable for rapidly evolving schemas and unstructured data.
whatToLearn: BSON document model, collections, and ObjectIDs
Mongoose ODM schemas, validation, and virtuals
Aggregation Pipeline ($match, $group, $project, $lookup)
When to choose SQL vs NoSQL document stores
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a multi-stage aggregation pipeline calculating monthly sales statistics from raw order documents.

stages.title: API Architectures & Protocols
stages.tagline: How frontend and backend exchange data efficiently and reliably.
stages.description: Full stack developers must design clean, predictable, documented APIs following international web standards.

topics.title: RESTful API Design Best Practices
topics.description: Architectural style for designing networked applications relying on standard HTTP verbs and stateless endpoints.
whatToLearn: Resource naming conventions (/api/v1/users/:id/orders)
Idempotency of GET, PUT, DELETE vs non-idempotent POST
Pagination patterns (offset/limit vs cursor-based pagination)
Filtering, sorting, and field selection query parameters
OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger specification documentation
topics.practiceChallenge: Document and implement a cursor-based paginated REST API endpoint with Swagger UI integration.

topics.title: WebSockets & Server-Sent Events
topics.description: Persistent full-duplex TCP connections for real-time live chat, notifications, and telemetry feeds.
whatToLearn: WebSocket handshake upgrade protocol (ws:// and wss://)
Socket.IO vs native WebSocket API
Heartbeat ping/pong and auto-reconnection logic
Server-Sent Events (SSE) for one-way streaming (e.g. AI LLM tokens)
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a real-time collaborative chat room with live typing indicators and online user lists.

topics.title: GraphQL (Client-Driven Queries)
topics.description: A query language for your API that allows clients to request exactly what they need and nothing more.
whatToLearn: Schema Definition Language (SDL): Types, Queries, Mutations
Resolvers and context handling
Solving the N+1 problem using DataLoader
GraphQL Subscriptions for real-time updates
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a GraphQL server with Apollo Server and optimize relations using DataLoader.

stages.title: Authentication & Web Security
stages.tagline: Safeguard user identities, protect against cyber attacks, and enforce access controls.
stages.description: Security is not an afterthought. Learn cryptographic password hashing, token validation, and OWASP defense patterns.

topics.title: JWT Tokens & HttpOnly Cookie Sessions
topics.description: Stateless JSON Web Tokens and secure session cookie storage for verifying user identity.
whatToLearn: Structure of JWT: Header, Payload, Signature
Access Token (short-lived) + Refresh Token (long-lived) rotation
HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie flags (preventing XSS theft)
Password hashing with bcrypt / argon2 (salting & work factors)
topics.practiceChallenge: Implement refresh token rotation with blacklist revocation in a Node.js / Express API.

topics.title: OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect
topics.description: Industry standard protocol for authorization allowing users to sign in with Google, GitHub, or Apple.
whatToLearn: Authorization Code Grant Flow with PKCE
Client ID, Client Secret, Redirect URI, and Scopes
ID Tokens vs Access Tokens in OIDC
Integrating Google / GitHub OAuth providers
topics.practiceChallenge: Add "Sign In With GitHub" to your web application using standard OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow.

topics.title: OWASP Top 10 Security Defenses
topics.description: Protect applications against common vulnerabilities: Injection, Broken Auth, XSS, CSRF, and Misconfigurations.
whatToLearn: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS): Stored, Reflected, DOM-based & Content Security Policy (CSP)
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) & SameSite cookies
SQL Injection (SQLi) & parameterized queries
CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) headers and preflight checks
Rate limiting, IP blacklisting, and DDOS mitigation
topics.practiceChallenge: Audit an existing web API for missing security headers, CSRF vulnerabilities, and SQL injection risks.

stages.description: High-performing engineering teams ship features with confidence by maintaining solid automated test suites.

topics.practiceChallenge: Write unit tests achieving 90%+ branch coverage for a financial billing calculator module.

topics.description: Automate real browser engines (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) to test complete user journeys end-to-end.
whatToLearn: Headless vs headed browser execution
Locators, auto-waiting, user actions (click, fill, press)
Network mocking and route interception in Playwright
Visual regression testing and screenshot comparisons
topics.practiceChallenge: Write an automated Playwright test that logs in, adds an item to cart, and verifies the total price.

stages.title: System Design & Distributed Systems
stages.tagline: Scale web applications to millions of concurrent users with fault-tolerant, resilient architectures.
stages.description: The transition from mid-level to senior/staff engineer requires mastering scalability bottlenecks, database sharding, and messaging queues.

topics.title: Monolith vs Microservices Architecture
topics.description: Evaluate architectural trade-offs between modular monoliths and independently deployable microservices.
whatToLearn: Modular Monolith advantages, boundaries, and domain-driven design (DDD)
Microservices challenges: network latency, distributed transactions, data consistency
API Gateway pattern and service mesh
Eventual consistency and the CAP theorem
topics.practiceChallenge: Design an architecture diagram for an Uber or Netflix scale system detailing service boundaries.

topics.title: Message Queues & Event Streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
topics.description: Asynchronous task processing and high-throughput event streaming between decoupled services.
whatToLearn: Point-to-point queues (RabbitMQ, SQS) vs Event logs (Apache Kafka)
Producers, Consumers, Consumer Groups, and Partitions
Background worker queues (BullMQ with Redis in Node.js)
Handling poison pills, dead-letter queues (DLQ), and retry exponential backoff
topics.practiceChallenge: Build an asynchronous email / video processing worker queue with BullMQ and Redis.

topics.title: Observability (Logging, Metrics, Tracing)
topics.description: Know what is happening inside production systems before users report bugs.
whatToLearn: Structured JSON logging (Pino, Winston) and log correlation IDs
Application metrics with Prometheus & visualization in Grafana
Distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry
Real-time error monitoring and alerting (Sentry)
topics.practiceChallenge: Add distributed correlation IDs to all incoming requests and trace them across HTTP headers.

stages.title: Docker, CI/CD & Cloud Deployment
stages.tagline: Package software into reproducible containers and automate continuous delivery to the cloud.
stages.description: A true full-stack engineer knows how to take raw code, containerize it, and deploy it securely to production servers.

topics.title: Docker & Containerization
topics.description: Package applications and all their dependencies into a standardized, isolated container unit.
whatToLearn: Images vs Containers, Docker Hub registry
Writing multi-stage Dockerfiles (build stage vs production stage)
Docker Compose for multi-service environments (App + Postgres + Redis)
Volumes for persistent storage and bridge networks
topics.practiceChallenge: Create a docker-compose.yml file that orchestrates a Next.js frontend, Node.js API, and PostgreSQL.

topics.title: CI/CD with GitHub Actions
topics.description: Automate testing, linting, building, and deployment pipelines directly on every push or pull request.
whatToLearn: Workflow YAML syntax: triggers, jobs, steps, runners
Matrix builds for multi-version testing
GitHub Secrets management for API keys and deployment credentials
Automated SSH deployment or Docker image build & push to registry
topics.practiceChallenge: Build a GitHub Actions workflow that runs linter, tests, builds production bundle, and notifies on failure.

topics.title: Web Servers & Reverse Proxy (Nginx)
topics.description: High-performance HTTP server, reverse proxy, and load balancer for routing traffic to backend containers.
whatToLearn: Reverse proxy configuration (proxy_pass to local ports)
SSL termination with Let’s Encrypt Certbot
Gzip compression, static file caching, and client body limits
Load balancing algorithms: round-robin, least connections, ip_hash
topics.practiceChallenge: Configure an Nginx reverse proxy routing requests for /api to a Node app and /* to static HTML files.

topics.title: Cloud VPS & Production Hosting
topics.description: Deploy real applications to Linux VPS servers (Hostinger VPS, DigitalOcean) and manage system services.
whatToLearn: Linux server administration basics (Ubuntu, SSH keys, ufw firewall)
Process management with PM2 / systemd services
Automated backups, log rotation, and disk space monitoring
Custom domain DNS mapping and free SSL certificates
topics.practiceChallenge: Provision an Ubuntu server, set up SSH key auth, configure UFW firewall, and run an app with PM2.
